title: 틀린 곳 {n}개를 찾아보세요! 👀
base_prompt: A cute hand-drawn children's book illustration of a sunny park playground, soft pastel colors, clean thick brown outlines, flat coloring. Include: a brown bear with a blue backpack waving, a pink bunny holding a blue star balloon, a yellow duck on a red swing set, a purple cat painting with a palette, a blue squirrel holding an acorn, a green frog by a small pond, a tulip flower bed, a wooden bench, a pink slide, two big trees with a small bird on a branch, fluffy clouds and a smiling sun. Rich detail, many small props, no text, no border, single image.

edits.label: 풍선 색
edits.instruction: Change the color of the bunny's star balloon from blue to yellow.

edits.label: 새 색깔
edits.instruction: Change the color of the small bird on the tree branch to bright blue.

edits.label: 도토리
edits.instruction: Remove the acorn from the squirrel's hands so its hands are empty.

edits.label: 가방 색
edits.instruction: Change the bear's backpack color from blue to red.

edits.label: 튤립 하나
edits.instruction: Remove exactly one tulip from the flower bed, leaving soil in its place.

edits.label: 개구리 왕관
edits.instruction: Put a tiny golden crown on the frog's head.
